title: Rumoured deep underground military bases

tellings.quote: and there are rumors of deep underground military bases from Edwards to Nellis to Peterson and Colorado and and Cheyenne Mountain Complex norat

plain: There are rumours of deep underground military bases stretching from Edwards and Nellis, two big Air Force bases in the American West, to Peterson in Colorado and the Cheyenne Mountain Complex, the bunker inside a Colorado mountain that houses NORAD, the US and Canadian air defence command. Michels mentions this himself as rumour, without naming a source; if true, it would mean a hidden world of facilities lies beneath known bases.
